evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Not asked. Rep went directly into logistics probing after the name collection, skipping the v4 primary opener about movers showing up on time or damage to items.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised two concerns early (certificate of insurance, experience with luxury apartments) but rep acknowledged and answered both with no follow-up depth. No 'tell me more about that' silence was held.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Not addressed. Rep never identified which day branch applied (Best Value, Standard, or Premium) or offered any day flexibility or dollar savings.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Rate lock and no deposit stated first: 'There's no deposit required, no recent securing your spot. If something comes up and change in your end, you can always reschedule or cancel with a quick call, no fees for that either that said it truly believe that we're the best move-in town would you like our help with your upcoming move?' Clear ask follows.

top_strength: Rep delivered both promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage at $2,000) with clear terms and conditions in step 3, and gave a fully personalized estimate (5–6 hours, 2 movers, $1,245) anchored to the customer's actual situation (one-bedroom items, two-bedroom destination, second floor with elevator, 30 minutes away).
coaching_note: Add the two-concerns question ('most people have one of two concerns: movers not showing up on time, or damage to their items') as your primary step 2 opener before any logistics probing, and hold silence for a real yes-or-no answer — this move unlocks the entire customer-first discovery arc that v4 is built around.
